title: Deaths from hunger and cold
summary: The unnamed president and accountant of the Diamond Club in Antwerp died from hunger and cold; the club itself is not a victim and Antwerp identifies the club, not necessarily the death place.
uncertaintyNote: The named club is associated with the deceased officials, who are not separately named.
